olean, prints signatures, re-checks axioms). Logs: _S1938compile.log / _S1938consumer.log.
REPORT: coord/reports/S1938-direct-312-inequality-actual.md

THE TARGET (no bridge, no S1880 route):
  S1938Target (l : PrimeGeFive) : Prop :=
    -|Real.log ‖S1487Cand.q‖| ≤ -s1904ProcessionAverage (s1903ActualDeterminant l)
  theorem s1938_target : S1938Target l
  s1938_neg_abs_log_q_le_neg_average : -|log q| ≤ -average   (paper form)
  s1938_average_le_abs_log_q : average ≤ |log q|
  s1938_average_lt_abs_log_q : average < |log q|   (strict)
  s1938_neg_magnitude_le_neg_average : -localLogMagnitude S1487Cand ≤ -average
  s1938_target_not_missing : ¬(|log q| < average)

PROOF CHAIN (all kernel-checked, unconditional in l):
  average = log5·(Σ_j j²)/l⁴ (s1928_average_eq)
  Σ_j j² ≤ l·lStar² ≤ l³   (l labels, |j| ≤ lStar = (l−1)/2 < l; s1938_sum_sq_le)
  ⇒ average ≤ log5/l ≤ log5/5 < 1 < log5 ≤ |log q| = localLogMagnitude S1487Cand
    (S1487Cand_magnitude_ge_log_five, s1938_one_lt_log_five).
  So your chain "average ≤ log5/l ≤ log5/5 < 1" is now fully formal, plus
  s1938_average_lt_one: average < 1 unconditionally at the S1903 determinant
  (S1904 only had average ≤ 1 under the bridge).

GENERAL INTERFACE (the useful part for S1939 / paper-faithful determinant):
  s1938_neg_abs_log_q_le_neg_average_of_le :
    ∀ P, s1904ProcessionAverage P ≤ log5 → -|log q| ≤ -s1904ProcessionAverage P
  s1938_neg_abs_log_q_le_neg_average_of_average_le_one :
    ∀ P, s1904ProcessionAverage P ≤ 1 → -|log q| ≤ -s1904ProcessionAverage P
  i.e. the 3.12 INEQUALITY needs only the determinant-side normalization
  average ≤ 1; it never needs the S1904 Haar bridge. S1939 only has to hit this.

BRIDGE INDEPENDENCE (proved):
  s1938_inequality_without_bridge (h : s1915ClosedForm T ≤ 0) :
    (average ≤ |log q|) ∧ ¬S1904ProcessionBridge (s1902ActualThetaHull T) (s1903ActualDeterminant l)
  s1938_S1905D_signed : OrigXiFSignedThetaHullLogVolume (S1905D T h) = -average
  s1938_S1905D_inequality / _magnitude :
    -|log q| ≤ OrigXiFSignedThetaHullLogVolume (S1905D T h)
  (h is used only to FORM the datum; the bridge equation is not used.)

WHAT I DO NOT CLAIM: s1903ActualDeterminant l is still the q=1/5 model, not the
paper's actual root-packet determinant (S1939). The S1904 bridge itself stays open.
So: no missing for the inequality; the remaining paper-level gaps are the S1939
determinant and (only if RHS must be read as actual hull log-vol) the bridge.

NOTES FOR YOU:
- Restating the inequality literally in another file needs the local
  Fact (Irreducible (X^2+1 : Polynomial Q)) instance of GaussianField (as in
  S1487/S1880); the theorems themselves are stated with it in scope.
- No upstream file modified. coord/STATE.md, coord/queue.md, AUDIT_LEDGER.md not
  touched (left to coordinator). Full project build / comparator not run.
